title: Security groups filter traffic
summary: A security group controls allowed traffic for attached resources. It is stateful: replies to allowed traffic are handled as part of that connection.
introduction: A security group controls allowed traffic for attached resources. It is stateful: replies to allowed traffic are handled as part of that connection. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A security group controls allowed traffic for attached resources. It is stateful: replies to allowed traffic are handled as part of that connection.

blocks.title: Security groups filter traffic

blocks.text: The web rule describes HTTPS traffic. Administrative access should be much more restricted.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A security group is not a substitute for patching software and checking application permissions.
